lines: A tagged pre-release is a release of its own: make changelog writes its section and make tag asks for it. The App Store shows it with the stable 36.0.0.
The App Store shows no changelog on the page of 36.0.0-dev.1.
For a version with a '-' it reads the Unreleased section, which is empty. The section of 36.0.0-dev.1 appears with the stable 36.0.0, below that release's own section.
